items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 171:1
items.html: (to the question) For the matter of the recognition of a Nukva in the nine upper Sefirot, above Malchut, was rooted by the force of the ascent of the Hey Tachtona [lower Hey] into the Hey Rishona [first Hey], which is the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, made in the second Tzimtzum [restriction], as is known. Thus even after the second Tzimtzum, the force of the Tzimtzum did not rise above Bina, which is Ima. Therefore there is no recognition of a Nukva above AVI [Aba ve Ima] — only from Ima and below. (Item 1)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 172:1
items.html: (to the question) For at the time of the breaking of the vessels, when the Lights departed from within the Kelim [vessels], they left behind them their Reshimot [records] in Atzilut, but the bodies of the Kelim and the sparks in them fell into BYA [Beria, Yetzira, Assiya]. Therefore, at the time of their correction, the essential Zivug [coupling] is made upon the Reshimot, which are the Lights, and these raise to themselves the Kelim and the sparks, according to the measure of the level of the Zivug of the Mayin Duchrin [male waters].

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 173:1
items.html: (to the question) See above, Answer 172.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 174:1
items.html: (to the question) The essential reason for the breaking of the vessels is the two forces that governed as one in the discernment of the Parsa of the second Tzimtzum [restriction] above BYA [Beria, Yetzira, Assiya], which are the Hey Rishona [first Hey] and the Hey Tachtona [lower Hey]. For after the new Light that split the Parsa clothed in the ZAT [seven lower ones] of Nekudim, when it reached the Parsa of the ending it did not discern the Parsa that had been spread there, in the place of Bina of the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK [Adam Kadmon], by the force of the second Tzimtzum; therefore the seven Kings spread down to the point of the first Tzimtzum, in the place of BYA. But the Hey Tachtona, which had taken her place in the Parsa, awakened at once with her force of Tzimtzum, and then the Lights of the seven Kings immediately departed to their place, and the seven Kings died, as is known. Now, had the force of the Bina of AK not been there in the Parsa, the seven Kings would certainly not have passed the boundary of the Parsa at all, just as they do not pass the boundary of the first Tzimtzum. And had the force of the Hey Tachtona not been in the Parsa, the Lights would not have departed from the seven Kings, and they would have remained alive, like the Partzufim of AK before the second Tzimtzum. Thus the whole cause of the breaking was that the Parsa was in the discernment of a public domain — that is, the discernment of Malchut and Bina governing there in mixture. And this was because the ZAT of Nekudim themselves were in the discernment of a single line, one below another; for the proper joining of the two Heys together existed only in the GAR of Nekudim, who received from its force the discernment of the correction of lines, which joins the two Heys together in the discernment of a single domain (as above in Answer 137, see there). Afterwards this correction was renewed in all the Partzufim of Atzilut, by the ascent of NHY [Netzah, Hod, Yesod] to HGT [Hesed, Gevura, Tiferet], "three within three," whereby the Hey Tachtona was joined to the Hey Rishona in the discernment of a single domain — such that from here on, even when the Partzufim receive the new Light from AB-SAG, which lowers the Hey Tachtona of the second Tzimtzum and returns their AHP [Awzen, Hotem, Peh] to their degree as at first, it will no longer happen that they spread because of this below the Parsa into BYA, for there is no longer any dominion there except of the Hey Tachtona alone. Rather, all the return of the AHP that comes by the force of the new Light of AB is only in the discernment of ascent alone: the former HGT became HBD and the NHY became HGT, and a place was cleared to receive there, in the place of the former NHY, the new NHY, which are the restored AHP. But in no way will the Light spread in the place of these AHP — that is, in BYA — except at the end of correction; then "the feet will reach the feet," and the feet of Atzilut will spread down to BYA, and not before. (p. 765, beginning "And you find")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 175:1
items.html: (to the question) For the Klipot [shells] take hold only in the ending forces of Kedusha [holiness]. And since the Parsa between Atzilut and BYA [Beria, Yetzira, Assiya] is the place of the boundary of the second Tzimtzum [restriction], therefore from there downward there is a structure of the Klipot, which suckle from the Lights that glimmer below the Tzimtzum, in the secret of Nehiru Dakik [a thin glow], as is known. But above the Parsa, there is the discernment of the line of Ein Sof, blessed be He, and "He, His life-force, and His organs are one in them." (There)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 176:1
items.html: Just as the Partzufim are explained according to the ten Sefirot, so they are explained according to the holy Names. And it is known that every complete Partzuf necessarily comprises five Partzufim: Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA, and BON. And likewise these five Partzufim exist in the totality of the whole world of Atzilut, and likewise in the totality of the world of AK [Adam Kadmon]. And the whole and the particulars are equal to one another, for every discernment in the lower one is drawn from its corresponding discernment in the upper one.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 176:2
items.html: Now the Partzuf Galgalta, which is the Partzuf of Keter of the degree or of the world, is the secret of the inner HaVaYaH, in which are the four letters Yod-Hey Vav-Hey. And from each letter in it, one Partzuf is drawn, in the discernment of a clothing for the inner HaVaYaH: from the Yod in it emerges the Partzuf AB; from the Hey in it emerges the Partzuf SAG; from the Vav in it emerges the Partzuf MA; and from the lower Hey in it emerges the Partzuf BON. As was explained regarding the five Partzufim of AK: after the departure of the Guf [body] of the Partzuf Galgalta, the Partzuf AB emerged in the secret of the second expansion, and filled with its Lights the ten Sefirot of the Guf of Partzuf Galgalta. Afterwards the ten Sefirot of the Guf of Partzuf AB also departed, and the Partzuf SAG emerged through the Zivug [coupling] of the Peh of AB, and filled with its Lights the ten Sefirot of the Guf of AB. Thus the first filling [Miluy] of the inner HaVaYaH is the Partzuf AB, which filled the ten Sefirot of the Guf of the Partzuf of the inner HaVaYaH. But the ten Sefirot of the Guf of AB also departed; hence it needs the second filling, of Partzuf SAG, and then the inner HaVaYaH is completed again — for that lack made by the departure of the ten Sefirot of AB, which are its first filling, was completed again by the Lights of SAG. Therefore AB is discerned as the first filling of the inner HaVaYaH, which is Yod-Vav-Dalet, Hey-Yod, Vav-Yod-Vav, Hey-Yod — ten letters. And the Partzuf SAG is discerned as coming and filling the lack made in the ten letters of the first filling — that is, in the discernment of the ten Sefirot of AB. Therefore SAG is called the filling of the filling: each and every letter of the ten letters of AB is filled individually, thus: Yod Vav Dalet; Hey Yod; Vav Yod Vav; Hey Yod — which are twenty-eight letters.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 176:3
items.html: (to the question) And it has been explained that the simple HaVaYaH is the Partzuf of Keter, for whose completion come the fillings of its letters, which are four clothings for it. The HaVaYaH in a filling of ten letters, which is the first filling of the simple HaVaYaH, is the Partzuf AB, which is its first clothing and filling. And the discernment of the filling-of-the-filling of the simple HaVaYaH, which is the above twenty-eight letters, is the Partzuf SAG, which is the second clothing, and the filling-of-the-filling of the simple HaVaYaH. These two clothings and fillings end above the Tabur [navel] of the simple HaVaYaH — that is, only upon its two letters Yod-Hey. Thus the letters Vav-Hey of the simple HaVaYaH still need clothings and fillings, and they are the two Partzufim called ZON, or MA and BON, which clothe it from the Tabur downward — that is, its letters Vav-Hey. (Item 89)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 179:1
items.html: (to the question) The HaVaYaH in its order — Yod-Hey Vav-Hey — indicates the discernment of the Panim [face] of the Partzuf. And the HaVaYaH in squaring, thus: Yod; Yod-Hey; Yod-Hey-Vav; Yod-Hey-Vav-Hey — indicates the discernment of the Achoraim [posterior] of that Partzuf. (Item 10)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 180:1
items.html: (to the question) The discernment of the Malchut or the Yesod, where the place of the Zivug [coupling] is — that is, the discernment of the Masach [screen] and the corrected Aviut [coarseness] there, from which, by the Returning Light rising from the Masach, all the Kelim [vessels] and Lights of that Partzuf spread — is titled the reckoning [Cheshbon] and Gematria of the Partzuf, namely the Gematria of the HaVaYaH: AB or SAG, etc. All of these indicate the discernments of the Masach and the Aviut corrected in the Masach of that degree.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 181:1
items.html: (to the question) The name MB [Mem-Bet, 42] of the male indicates the three first Partzufim of the Partzufim of AK [Adam Kadmon] — Galgalta, AB, SAG — which end above the Tabur [navel] of AK. And the discernments of the Mayin Duchrin [male waters] are drawn from them, because they are above the dominion of the second Tzimtzum [restriction]; for the discernment of the second Tzimtzum begins only from the Tabur of AK and below, as is known. And since there is nothing of the second Tzimtzum in them, their illumination is potent to lower the Hey Tachtona [lower Hey] from the Eynaim [eyes] and return the AHP [Awzen, Hotem, Peh] to their place. (Item 89)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IX, List of Answers on Topics 183:1
items.html: (to the question) A seal [Chotam] carries the meaning of a boundary, and the meaning of engraving — like the seal that is impressed upon wax, whose markings remain sunk and engraved in the wax. And there are two seals in the Nukva, which are the Yesod and the Malchut in her: the Yesod is the inner seal, and from it the second, outer seal is stamped, in the secret of "the inner seal within the outer seal." The inner one is called Zion, which is the Yesod in her; and the outer one is called Jerusalem, which is the Malchut in her. And they have Katnut and Gadlut. For at first, while she cleaves to ZA [Zeir Anpin] Achor be Achor [back-to-back], she takes these two seals, Yesod and Malchut, from ZA, in the secret of the engraving of the Gevurot of the discernment of "bent fire"; and then both are judgments, and therefore both are called Jerusalem — for even the Yesod in her is then called Jerusalem, since even the inner seal is still considered like the outer seal, being discernments of judgments, and the difference between them is not yet so recognizable. But afterwards, after the Nesira [sawing apart], when her fallen Achoraim [posterior] are returned to her for the building of her Partzuf, and she has the ten Sefirot of Gadlut in completeness, then the NHY [Netzah, Hod, Yesod] of Ima clothe in her, which are three names of EKYEH: with Yods, with Alephs, with Heys — and these three fillings are, in Gematria, Chotam [seal], with the inclusive one. This intimates that she takes the two above seals again, by means of Ima, and with this the seals are completed in the secret of a seal within a seal, for now they have attained the discernment of the Gadlut in them. And the five Gevurot of Ima, which are the secret of the second MANTZEPACH that the Nukva now receives, are guarded within the Yesod of the Nukva, in the discernment of a seal within a seal, in the secret of "the wine that gladdens." And these two discernments of seals that she received from Ima are the Yesod and Malchut of Gadlut, and both are called Zion, relative to the Yesod and Malchut of Katnut that she received from ZA, which are called Jerusalem, as above. But the Gadlut and Katnut join together; hence the Yesod in her is now called Zion, and the inner seal, and the present Malchut is called Jerusalem, and the outer seal. In this way the guarding of "a seal within a seal" is explained: for only in Gadlut are the essence of the Gevurot received, called "the wine that gladdens," which need superior guarding, a seal within a seal. And with this all the variations of language found in the words of the Rav are explained. (p. 781, Item 73; and Item 75; and Item 72; and p. 794, Item 92 and Item 93; and Item 95)
